visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a white t-shirt and a young woman with long dark hair sit at a desk in a home office, looking at a laptop and laughing. A graphic of a baby holding a banana is overlaid in the center. The background features shelves filled with toys, photos, and personal items under bright indoor lighting. (2) The woman sits alone at a wooden desk with a large monitor and her laptop. She is in a video call with another woman who wears glasses. The room is warmly lit with bookshelves and a bicycle visible in the background. (3) A close-up shot introduces a sleek, grey rectangular device with a circular dial and a red button. Text overlays appear identifying it as the 'HiDock P1'. The camera focuses on the textures and buttons of the device held in a hand. (4) The woman is now outdoors in a lush green park, wearing a pink t-shirt and denim skirt. She holds the device, demonstrating its size and portability. The lighting is natural daylight filtered through trees. (5) Back indoors at a cafe, the woman works on her laptop while using the grey device. She wears earbuds and seems focused. The cafe has a modern, clean aesthetic with wooden furniture. (6) A series of screen captures show the device's software interface on a laptop, displaying transcribed text and meeting summaries in Traditional Chinese. (7) A man's hands are seen placing the device on a table where people are playing a card game, demonstrating a different recording environment. (8) At night, the woman walks through a traditional-looking alleyway with red brick walls, speaking into the device as if it were a microphone. The scene is lit by warm street lamps.
